license_required.quote: It is unlawful for any person to practice medicine or osteopathic medicine in this state without holding a license or permit to do so, as provided in this article.

issuing_authority.quote: "Board" refers to the medical licensing board of Indiana.

name.quote: "Board" refers to the medical licensing board of Indiana.

type.quote: "Board" refers to the medical licensing board of Indiana.

umbrella_agency.quote: "Agency" refers to the Indiana professional licensing agency under IC 25-1-5.

degree_required.value: Doctor of Medicine or Doctor of Osteopathy
degree_required.quote: The applicant shall possess the degree of doctor of medicine or doctor of osteopathy or its equivalent from a medical school which was approved by the board as of the time the degree was conferred.

accrediting_body.value: Board-approved medical school (nationally accredited college of medicine or osteopathic medicine)
accrediting_body.quote: "Medical school" means a nationally accredited college of medicine or of osteopathic medicine approved by the board.

required.quote: The applicant shall have completed one (1) year of postgraduate training in a hospital or institution located in the United States, its possessions, or Canada that meets standards set by the board under IC 25-22.5-2-7.

duration.quote: The applicant shall have completed one (1) year of postgraduate training in a hospital or institution located in the United States, its possessions, or Canada

kind.quote: completed one (1) year of postgraduate training in a hospital or institution located in the United States, its possessions, or Canada that meets standards set by the board

exams.name: Indiana Medical Licensing Examination
exams.notes: Board prepares or approves examination; applicant must achieve passing score
exams.quote: prepare and give, or approve the preparation and giving of, an examination which covers those general subjects and topics, a knowledge of which is commonly and generally required, in the opinion of the board, to practice medicine or osteopathic medicine in Indiana

interval_years.quote: a license issued under this article expires biennially on the date established by the licensing agency under IC 25-1-5-4

available.quote: The board in its discretion may register as a physician and may issue by endorsement an unlimited license to practice medicine or osteopathic medicine to any applicant who has complied with the minimum requirements of IC 25-22.5-3; and passed an examination for licensure in another state or territory of the United States, or Canada

requirements.value: Applicant must have complied with minimum requirements and passed an equivalent examination in another state, territory, or Canada, or passed an examination given by a recognized certifying agency approved by the board.
requirements.quote: passed an examination for licensure in another state or territory of the United States, or Canada; or given by a recognized certifying agency approved by the board; if that examination was, in the opinion of the board, equivalent in every respect to Indiana's examination at the time it was taken.

regulatory_model.quote: It is unlawful for any person to practice medicine or osteopathic medicine in this state without holding a license or permit to do so, as provided in this article.

credential_type.quote: Issue an unlimited license, a limited license, or a temporary medical permit, depending upon the qualifications of the applicant, to any applicant who successfully fulfills all of the requirements of this article.

is_mandatory.quote: It is unlawful for any person to practice medicine or osteopathic medicine in this state without holding a license or permit to do so, as provided in this article.

title_protection.quote: Attaching to a name, either alone or in connection with other words, the designation or term: "doctor of medicine"; "M.D."; "doctor of osteopathy"; "D.O."; "physician"

scope_protection.quote: A person who knowingly or intentionally violates this article by unlawfully practicing medicine or osteopathic medicine commits a Class C felony (for a crime committed before July 1, 2014) or a Level 5 felony (for a crime committed after June 30, 2014).

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud in connection with licensure renewal

disciplinary_grounds.quote: Improper termination of a physician and patient relationship.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing medicine with an expired medical license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing with an expired medical license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Providing office-based anesthesia without proper accreditation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Providing office based anesthesia without the proper accreditation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to perform duties required for issuing birth or death certificates
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to perform duties required for issuing birth or death certificates.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to disclose or negligent omission of documentation requested for licensure renewal
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to disclose, or negligent omission of, documentation requested for licensure renewal.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to complete or timely transmit a pregnancy termination form
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to complete or timely transmit a pregnancy termination form under IC 16-34-2-5, with each failure constituting a separate violation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly participating in or attempting cloning
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the board shall revoke the license of a physician if, after appropriate notice and an opportunity for a hearing, the attorney general proves by a preponderance of the evidence that the physician knowingly participated in cloning or attempted cloning.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing an abortion in violation of certain statutes or failing to transmit required pregnancy termination report
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the board shall revoke the license of a physician if, after appropriate notice and an opportunity for a hearing, the attorney general proves by a preponderance of the evidence that the physician performed an abortion in violation of IC 16-34-2-7(a) through IC 16-34-2-7(c) with the intent to avoid the requirements of IC 16-34-2-1.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitting or authorizing a person to fill or refill a prescription for a legend drug except as authorized by law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A physician licensed in Indiana who permits or authorizes a person to fill or refill a prescription or drug order for a legend drug except as authorized in IC 16-42-19-11 through IC 16-42-19-19 is subject to disciplinary action under IC 25-1-9.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with board-developed protocols for experimental or nonconventional medical treatments
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A physician who fails to comply with a protocol developed under this subsection shall be subject to discipline by the medical licensing board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having had disciplinary action taken against the applicant or license due to inability to safely practice medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The applicant shall not have had disciplinary action taken against the applicant or the applicant's license by the board or by the licensing agency of any other state or jurisdiction by reasons of the applicant's inability to safely practice medicine or osteopathic medicine

definition_quote.value: "Practice of medicine or osteopathic medicine" means any one (1) or a combination of the following: (1) Holding oneself out to the public as being engaged in: (A) the diagnosis, treatment, correction, or prevention of any disease, ailment, defect, injury, infirmity, deformity, pain, or other condition of human beings; (B) the suggestion, recommendation, or prescription or administration of any form of treatment, without limitation; (C) the performing of any kind of surgical operation upon a human being...
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of medicine or osteopathic medicine" means any one (1) or a combination of the following: (1) Holding oneself out to the public as being engaged in: (A) the diagnosis, treatment, correction, or prevention of any disease, ailment, defect, injury, infirmity, deformity, pain, or other condition of human beings

value: diagnosis, treatment, correction, or prevention of disease
suggestion, recommendation, prescription or administration of any form of treatment
surgical operations including use of mechanical means, laser, or ionizing radiation
prevention of physical, mental, or functional ailment or defect
maintenance of office for reception, examination, or treatment of patients
telehealth diagnostic or treatment services transmitted through electronic communications
methods_authorized.quote: the diagnosis, treatment, correction, or prevention of any disease, ailment, defect, injury, infirmity, deformity, pain, or other condition of human beings; (B) the suggestion, recommendation, or prescription or administration of any form of treatment, without limitation; (C) the performing of any kind of surgical operation upon a human being

drug_authority.value: Physicians may prescribe drugs and medicines; prescribing means to direct, order, or designate the use of or manner of using a drug, medicine, or treatment by spoken or written words or other means.
drug_authority.quote: "Prescribe or prescription" means to direct, order, or designate the use of or manner of using a drug, medicine, or treatment, by spoken or written words or other means and in accordance with IC 25-1-9.3.

license_status_types.quote: Issue an unlimited license, a limited license, or a temporary medical permit, depending upon the qualifications of the applicant

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Foreign medical graduates must complete a minimum of two years of postgraduate training in a US or Canadian hospital meeting nationally recognized accrediting body standards, in addition to all other requirements except the standard one-year postgraduate training requirement.
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: an applicant for licensure who has been graduated from a medical school outside the United States, its possessions, or Canada; and submits evidence satisfactory to the board that prior to passing the examination the applicant has successfully completed a minimum of at least two (2) years of postgraduate training in a hospital or an institution located in the United States or Canada

postgraduate_training_years_required.quote: The applicant shall have completed one (1) year of postgraduate training in a hospital or institution located in the United States, its possessions, or Canada that meets standards set by the board under IC 25-22.5-2-7.

opioid_prescribing_limits.value: The board must adopt rules establishing standards and protocols for prescribing controlled substances; the board must also adopt rules setting forth conditions exempted from opioid prescribing limitations under IC 25-1-9.7-2(a).
opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: Adopt rules establishing standards and protocols for the prescribing of controlled substances.

controlled_substance_database_registrati.quote: "INSPECT program" means the Indiana scheduled prescription electronic collection and tracking program established by IC 25-1-13-4.

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: The board may adopt rules establishing guidelines for the practice of telehealth in Indiana; telehealth diagnostic or treatment services transmitted through electronic communications on a regular, routine, and nonepisodic basis or under an oral or written agreement to regularly provide medical services constitutes practice of medicine.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: The board may adopt rules under IC 4-22-2 establishing guidelines for the practice of telehealth in Indiana. Adoption of rules under this subsection may not delay the implementation and provision of telehealth services by a provider under IC 25-1-9.5.

interstate_medical_licensure_compact_mem.quote: Administer the interstate medical licensure compact under IC 25-22.5-16, including appointing members to the interstate medical licensure compact commission and adopting any rules necessary to administer the compact.

physician_assistant_supervision_model.quote: "Physician assistant" means an individual who: (1) has a collaborative agreement with a physician

malpractice_reporting_required.quote: In making that determination, the board may consider any malpractice settlements or judgments against the applicant.

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: The applicant shall be physically and mentally capable of, and professionally competent to, safely engage in the practice of medicine or osteopathic medicine as determined by the board and shall submit: (1) to an examination; or (2) additional evidence to the board; if considered necessary by the board to determine such capability.

locum_tenens_permit_available.quote: A person who is licensed to practice medicine or osteopathic medicine by any board or licensing agency of another state or jurisdiction, and who meets the requirements established by the board under IC 25-22.5-2-7, may be issued a temporary medical permit limited by terms and conditions considered appropriate by the board.

investigational_drug_protection.quote: This section does not create a cause of action against a health care provider involved in connection with the use of an investigational drug, biological product, or device by a patient for any harm to the patient from the investigational drug, biological product, or device.
